description: PLC and HMI control of drying ovens, vacuum oil processing, winding machines, CNC core lines, welding, and crane systems

manual_workaround: Plants work the released queue; planners re-sequence by spreadsheet from the Monday schedule export for up to 1 week at reduced output
dependent_people_or_facilities: 8 plant planning teams; central scheduling (about 90 planners)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-G01, BP-G03, BP-G04; feeds BP-EU03 (storm transformers for the Electric Utility)

manual_workaround: Spare yard register printed weekly; release by phone and paper bills of lading signed by the yard manager
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds BP-EU03; demand forecast AI-001 sets reserved slots (P10)

manual_workaround: Printed storm stock list; direct phone orders to the Manufacturing storm desk
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-G04 and BP-MF07; a GEPS outage hits this process and its supplier at the same time

description: Work order dispatch, electronic travelers, labor and material confirmation, and test data capture on about 1,150 kiosks

description: Bills of lading, restricted-party screening, export documentation, and carrier booking
